secrets.name: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
secrets.description: Firebase Admin service account JSON (from Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts > Generate new private key). Paste the entire JSON content. Required for backend Firebase operations (auth verification, Firestore, user management, messaging).

secrets.name: OPENAI_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI-guided incident reporting chat. Optional — the backend falls back to a scripted response when not set.

secrets.name: EMAIL_USER
secrets.description: Gmail address for sending report notification emails. Optional — email notifications are skipped when not set.

secrets.name: EMAIL_PASS
secrets.description: Gmail app password for EMAIL_USER. Optional — skipped when not set.

secrets.name: EMAIL_TO
secrets.description: Recipient email address for new report notifications. Optional — skipped when not set.

secrets.name: AZURE_FACE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Azure AI Face API key for optional face-login enrollment/verification. Optional — face login shows a 'service unavailable' message when not set.

secrets.name: AZURE_FACE_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Azure AI Face endpoint URL (e.g. https://YOUR-RESOURCE.cognitiveservices.azure.com). Optional.
